neighbours.label: the ' re' of 'reprinted' in a publication credit (an essay or story reprinted from or by a publisher), as against other re- words and other publication credits
fire: The poem first came out in a small magazine and was reprinted in his collected works.
Her lecture from 1975 is reprinted here with the kind permission of the family.
This chapter was originally written for a journal and is reprinted by permission.
The famous letter was reprinted in several newspapers the following week.
Note: the story below is reprinted from materials supplied by the university.
His 1958 review, reprinted in a later anthology, is still widely quoted.
Several of the essays were reprinted in a paperback edition in 1990.
The interview, reprinted with permission of the editors, appears on page 12.
quiet: The poem first came out in a small magazine and was praised by his friends.
Her lecture from 1975 is quoted here with the kind help of the family.
This chapter was originally written for a journal and later expanded.
The famous letter was returned to the archive the following week.
Note: the story below is based on interviews with former students.
His 1958 review, rediscovered in an attic, is still widely quoted.
Several of the essays were revised for a paperback edition in 1990.
The interview, recorded in the editors' office, appears on page 12.
